div.div:
How it holds together
OpenBao never starts sealed for long: each pod unwraps its root key from floci (the local stand-in for a cloud KMS), so the bootstrap Job only initialises it once, writes the recovery key, seeds KV, creates the eso-reader / db-configurator / oidc-configurator roles and revokes the root token. External Secrets logs in with Kubernetes auth and re-reads every hour; notification's password comes from the database engine instead and is re-read every minute, because OpenBao rotates it.

div.div:
Planned, not deployed
TLS on the OpenBao listener, a real cloud KMS instead of floci, AppRole for CI/CD, per-request dynamic database credentials and internal TLS on homelab-ca (RFC-0020). Locally the edge certificate is issued by homelab-ca; Let's Encrypt DNS-01 with the Cloudflare token is the production path.
